sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Lightning Release

system.description:
You select a target within range conjure a neon pillar of light before dropping it upon them forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 5d6 lightning damage and are Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature takes 5d6 lightning damage and roll 1d6, gaining the listed condition (1 or 2: Blinded, 3 or 4: Deafened, 5 or 6: Both Blinded & Deafened), until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the condition the affected creature gains lasts for 1 minute, as they make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the conditions they gain as a result of this jutsu.

Angel Link: Select two additional creatures for this jutsu to target.

Demon Link: For the duration of the affected creature condition, once per turn, if an attack targeting them would score a hit, the data release blinding or deafening them detonates within them, inflicting them with 1 rank of Concussed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d6.
